card.name: Neuro- and electro- word openings
card.fires_on: The opening piece "neuro" or "electro" at the start of a long medical term, such as neurotoxicity, neuromuscular, electrolyte or electrocardiographic. Mostly in warning headings and section titles.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward finishing the word, and away from exclamation marks.
card.plain: It lights up on the first part of long words that begin with neuro- or electro-, before the rest of the word appears.
